Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas · School & learning

attend verb

be present at

also be present at, go to a meeting, attend a lecture, attendance

classical

Tac. Dial. 34.2–3: hujus omnibus dictiōnibus interesse
Traupman 127: saltātiōnī intererō
M-O s.v. attend, take (a class, course): lēctiōnibus interesse

intersum, interesse, interfuī

verb, irregular (sum); with the dative

be present at, attend

Lewis & Short: “to be present at, take part in, attend”. For taking part, see be involved.

Other words

  • adsum, adesse, adfuī — be there, be present (at)

    verb, irregular (sum); with the dative · also used · classical · Ov. Tr. 4.10.11: Lūcifer ambōrum nātālibus adfuit īdem; Traupman 295: concentuī adesse

  • frequentō, frequentāre, frequentāvī, frequentātum — attend regularly (a school, lectures)

    verb, first conjugation, transitive · also used · classical · Traupman 31, 76, 374: scholam frequentāre; M-O s.v. attend, go to (a university, school)

    Classically to visit a place or a person often (Lewis & Short: “to visit or resort to frequently, to frequent”); see go to school.

  • frequentia, frequentiae f. — attendance, a full house

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.200 (Lewis & Short): maximā … frequentiā cīvium

    Lewis & Short: “a numerous attendance … (class.; a favorite expression of Cicero)”.

  • attendō, attendere, attendī, attentum — pay attention

    verb, third conjugation · avoid · classical · Phaedr. 2.5.6: pretium est operae attendere

    Latin attendō is to pay attention (see pay attention!), never to be present at something.

Examples

  • hunc sectārī, hunc prōsequī, hujus omnibus dictiōnibus interesse … adsuēscēbat

    He would get used to following him about, escorting him, being present at all his speeches.Tac. Dial. 34.2–3

  • Lūcifer ambōrum nātālibus adfuit īdem: ūna celebrāta est per duo lība diēs

    The same morning star was there at both our births: one day was kept with two birthday cakes.Ov. Tr. 4.10.11–12

  • Crās convīviō intereris?

    Will you be at the dinner tomorrow?composed

See also be involved, go to school, pay attention!, concert.
